title: Chapter 841
paragraphs: Chapter 841
Episode 209. The Seventh Tomb of Temar - Kaytam's Painting (14)
Temar stared at Murakan with contempt in his eyes.
"Me, destroy this moon? The Kingdom of Paddler? Don't tell me you used such nonsense as a justification when you killed your comrades and the knights of our family?"
Murakan pulled out the Barisada that was stuck in his chest. Temar tried to retrieve the blade that Murakan was holding, but the blade didn't budge.
"Nonsense... yes, I wish it was nonsense. I so desperately wished that all of this was just a terrible dream."
A black tear streamed down Murakan's cheek from a thousand years ago.
Beyond the blurred vision, what Murakan was looking at was not Temar in front of him. Murakan was facing the truth of the Ten Knights he had no choice but to kill himself.
The reason Murakan massacred Dranaks and Kamalga was that they eventually collapsed due to the manipulation of Zipple's history.
"Dranaks, why... why are you doing this? What's the reason for the massacre...? Moreover, you even attacked and exterminated the allied families of Piros, Ville, and Raigon recently."
Dranaks blinked his eyes as if he didn't understand what Murakan was saying.
"What are you talking about? When did I do that?"
"What...?"
Outside Dranaks' camp, the blood of the commoners they killed was forming a river. Murakan had confirmed this scene just a few minutes ago and hurriedly descended to the camp.
Moreover, the massacre didn't just take place near the camp. Most of the villages and cities they saw on the way had turned into ruins of death. They were all on Dranaks' route.
"You bastard... you don't remember what you just did?"

"Oh, cut it out! This guy, I'm already exhausted from fighting the Zipple bastards, why are you suddenly coming and babbling nonsense, it's insane. Are you having a hard time these days? So you've lost your mind?"
"Please don't do this, Dranaks. You can't do this... pull yourself together. You've been doing well against the historical manipulation so far, right?"
"What historical manipulation are you talking about? What is that?"
A normal conversation was impossible.
Dranaks had been completely consumed by Zipple's historical manipulation. He and Kamalga continued to carry out massacres, completely unaware of what they were doing, unable to even remember it.
When they killed people, members of Dranaks and Kamal turned into monsters. Their bodies turned purple and their facial features disappeared, tearing people apart emotionlessly.
Even the children turned into such monsters. When the time for the massacre approached, even the young children who couldn't wield a sword transformed into monsters and roamed the city.
And when the transformation subsided, they couldn't remember anything, not even the existence of 'historical manipulation.'
Lokia referred to this state as 'ghostification.'

"Murakan, even the witches said there's no way for those who have become ghosts due to historical manipulation. The condition is going to get worse. The intensity of the slaughter and massacres will also gradually increase, and if there's no one around to kill, they'll end up hurting each other. If even that's not possible, they'll hurt themselves...."
Lokia had already finished several experiments on those who were consumed by ghostification.
"I even said I would offer whatever sacrifices I could to the witches, but unless some god we don't know resurrects, it's absolutely impossible to break the ghostification."
"The others... damn it... even if the others don't know, Temar is a person who transcends fate. Did you say that even he has no way back?"

"There might be variables that even the witches can't anticipate, given that Temar is the head of the family. However, not only is he in the state of ghostification, but he's also undergoing devilification. Even if they all return to how they were, those they've already killed won't come back to life. We have to admit it, Murakan. We, lost."
"Shut up, Lokia."

"Paddler became a vengeful ghost due to the shock of the family head destroying the moon, and Dranaks, Violo, Frey became ghosts of historical manipulation. Most of the remaining comrades are in a dangerous state too. Where is hope? If you want to save the remaining ones, you have to stop the war."
"Shut up!"

"Now that the family head has turned into a monster, you're the only one who can persuade the steward and the remaining comrades. Think about what's right. While you're ignoring reality, the family head and our comrades continue the massacre. They're destroying the people we were trying to protect, the land we were trying to protect, everything, with their own hands."
Murakan didn't listen to Lokia anymore.
He couldn't listen. Even without Lokia telling him, Murakan himself knew better than anyone else.
The fact that there's no more hope.
Ten days after that, Murakan visited Dranaks again. Throughout those ten days, Dranaks and Kamal had been incessantly getting their hands bloody with blood that should not have been shed.
Murakan felt a guilt he couldn't shake off for them and for those they had killed.
[I'm sorry, Dranaks. For me... this is all I can do...]

"Murakan, everyone suspected you were a traitor, but I believed in you. I was even so angry that I almost knocked out my younger brother and the food sols when they said they couldn't trust you anymore. But in the end, this is how I get stabbed in the back."
Murakan thought it would be better for Dranaks to resent him while facing his end.
"Dying while remembering the massacres and atrocities unknowingly committed would undoubtedly be better than this," he reasoned to himself.

Above all, Murakan thought he deserved resentment and curses. Even though he had such great power, he failed to prevent his comrades from turning into specters. Taking the lives of his comrades was the only thing he could do.
"Dracnax, don't forgive me."
"Whether my eyes are closed or open, I can't forget their eyes full of hatred. Like you now, they must have truly felt that I betrayed them."
Temar continued to try to pull his sword free. The aura and spiritual energy concentrated on the blade exploded several times, piercing Murakan's hand, but Murakan didn't move.
Violo Runcandel.
When he came to seek revenge for Dracnax, Murakan was burying the dead at the hands of Violo.
Violo had no reaction to the corpses scattered all around. He acted as if the bodies did not exist.

"No, you should forget us. We won't be able to forget you even in death. We don't want to be remembered by you. Even as specters, we will curse you, and curse you again. The future that Solderet desired will eventually meet a dark end soaked in curses and blood."
Murakan's heart was breaking.
Even while Violo was pouring out his bitter words full of resentment, Murakan silently dug the ground and buried the bodies for a while.
And after he took Violo's life.

He couldn't bear to bury him there. Murakan flew to a distant island to bury Violo. The graves he had made for Dracnax and Kamarga had already been found by Zipple, who left no trace behind after destroying them.
Violo's grave soon met the same fate. Murakan no longer had the strength to protect the graves where he buried his comrades.
Shak...!
Eventually, the blade of Barisada slipped from Murakan's grip. Temar distanced himself and prepared his spiritual sword again, and Murakan muttered to himself.
"Yes, just as you said... What I did cannot be justified. Regardless of the reason, I failed to protect my comrades. I abandoned those who believed in and depended on me."
The reason why people no longer lived near the Murakan mountains.
It was because Temar, the ten knights, and the specters from the history manipulation were committing massacres.
Refugees were pouring out not only near the Murakan mountain range but across the whole Huphester Alliance.
And Frey was leading them every day. He couldn't sleep for even a moment, as he was busy commanding the battlefield to keep the refugees from getting hurt in the ongoing attacks by Zipple.
When night fell.

The refugees who trusted and followed Frey met their death at the hands of her, who had turned into a specter. When her transformation into a specter was lifted, Frey thought that all the bodies scattered around had been victims of Murakan.
She moved with a sense of duty to save the innocent people by any means possible, rather than harboring resentment towards Murakan like Dracnax or Violo.
So, when Murakan came to find her, she fought and somehow escaped. To save even one more person from Murakan. Unaware that she was actually the perpetrator of the massacre.
Murakan could have easily killed the fleeing Frey.

Each time, Murakan could not pursue her to the end. He couldn't bear to trample on her desperate heart to save people, reflected in her eyes. Even knowing that losing her would ultimately result in more people dying, his already broken heart couldn't grasp the situation.
"What I'm experiencing now... all... you are... Zipple's manipulation... tell me it's true...."
"Frey, you're right. All of this is manipulation. I've gone mad from Zipple's history manipulation, and you've saved countless people from me. So now... rest."
"If I knew this would happen, I wouldn't have loved you... if I knew I would end up hating you this way."
The black smoke that once again escaped from Murakan was cut by Temar's spirit sword.
The Murakan of a thousand years ago no longer felt pain.
Because he had no more heart left to suffer. His mind, already devastated as it could be, was only thinking of one duty.
The sense of duty to grant rest to Temar and his comrades. The sense of mission to stop their slaughter and protect the remaining ones was the only thing that kept Murakan moving.
Kept him fighting.

"You're the last one, Temar. I wish you were the last. And I've already sought you out more than ten times. Believing that you, if anyone, could cut through this terrible fate one more time. I've really done all I could. But there's nothing I can do. Today I must kill you and end this war. We will be completely erased from history."
Murakan transformed into his true form, spreading his two pairs of wings. The black smoke that had been absorbed by the spirit sword quickly disappeared into the darkness of the spirit energy.
